verdict.rationale: Synctera documents an API-first platform with its own APIs for personal and business customers, accounts, cards, internal transfers, scheduled payments, KYC/KYB verification and webhooks, and it publishes an OpenAPI spec. Nothing states that the API matches the UI, and console-side features (team admin access control, case notifications, the operational workflow platform) have no documented API equivalents. Missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity statement, documented API coverage of console functions like team access management and case handling, and independent or hands-on confirmation that UI actions can be automated.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: Once an API key is issued in Sandbox, you can immediately start calling the APIs below.
The Internal Transfer API allows you to transfer funds between two Synctera accounts, in real-time.
The Webhook API enables integrators to subscribe to specific events on the Synctera platform.
